data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).

**Target:** A **THOUSAND SONS PSYKER** unit of yours in range of an [objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) that you control and that is wholly within the [Flow of Magic](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.hexwarp-thrallband.flow-of-magic) of your army.

**Effect:** That objective stays under your control until a phase ends with your opponent holding a higher [Level of Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) over it than you.

target.inRangeOf: controlled objective marker wholly within Flow of Magic

effect.endsWhen: higher opposing level of control over the marker at phase end
